dict.string: RapidCulling needs access to your external drives to browse, cull and move the photos stored on them.
RapidCulling needs access to network drives to browse, cull and move the photos stored on them.
RapidCulling needs access to your Desktop folder to browse, cull and move the photos in it.
RapidCulling needs access to your Documents folder to browse, cull and move the photos in it.
RapidCulling needs access to your Downloads folder to browse, cull and move the photos in it.
